data.areasOfConcern: Exploration of the oceans, mapping and documenting marine lore, and reverence for bioluminescence and underwater wonders
edicts: Seek out undiscovered marvels on and beneath the sea, preserve historical knowledge and artifacts, protect oceanic sites from exploitation
anathema: Avoid deep explorations, create false maps and records, disrespect sacred sites, and mislead navigators.
data.rulesText:
**Areas of Concern** Exploration of the oceans, mapping and documenting marine lore, and reverence for bioluminescence and underwater wonders

**Edicts** Seek out undiscovered marvels on and beneath the sea, preserve historical knowledge and artifacts, protect oceanic sites from exploitation

**Anathema** Avoid deep explorations, create false maps and records, disrespect sacred sites, and mislead navigators.

**Divine Attribute** Constitution, Intelligence

**Divine Font** [Heal](/spell/heal-player-core)

**Divine Skill** Athletics

**Favored Weapon** [Trident](/item/trident-player-core)

**Domains** [Knowledge](/domain/knowledge), [Might](/domain/might), [Travel](/domain/travel), [Truth](/domain/truth)

**Alternate Domains** [Air](/domain/air), [Water](/domain/water)

**Cleric Spells** [Tailwind](/spell/tailwind-player-core), [Feet to Fins](/spell/feet-to-fins-player-core), [Retrocognition](/spell/retrocognition-player-core)
